blocks.text: RIO DE JANEIRO, Brazil – Brazil voted Sunday in a knife-edge election between right-wing senator Flavio Bolsonaro and leftist incumbent Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, who called for voting hours to be extended over obstacles to public transport in some cities. Lula, who turns 81 next week, is facing stiff competition from the son of jailed former president Jair Bolsonaro, who won the most first-round votes.
